hero.subtitle: Section 1: core Python and AI labs. From Stage 3: customer story with Todo tutor labs and Ask IT assignments.

phases.label: Section 1 · 16 h
phases.detail: Stages 1–2: Python and AI engineering foundations (5h + 11h)

phases.label: Section 2 · 16 h
phases.detail: Stages 3–9: FDE SDLC — Requirements to Production & Handover (7 stages)

phases.label: Section 3 · 16 h
phases.detail: Stage 10: Four 4-Hour Capstone Projects (Full-Stack, Multi-Agent, Agentic RAG, Integration)

capabilities: Write reliable Python that calls APIs, validates data with Pydantic and ships as a tested FastAPI service
Prompt, evaluate, and connect LLMs with structured output, tools, RAG, and LangGraph agents
Run structured customer discovery and author a crisp one-page business requirements document (BRD)
Define user flows, wireframes, reference architecture, role-based access, and latency/cost trade-offs
Develop, test, and harden customer solutions locally with a 20-question regression set
Deploy to Render or AWS with secrets in env, Langfuse traces/evals, and incident runbooks
Complete IT security questionnaires, run sponsor readouts, and deliver production handover packages
Deliver 4 hands-on capstone projects: E-commerce full-stack, multi-agent orchestration, agentic RAG, and unified integration

faq.question: How long does this roadmap take?
faq.answer: 48 hours total, divided into three 16-hour sections: Section 1 (Foundations, 16h), Section 2 (FDE SDLC, 16h), and Section 3 (Capstone Projects, 16h). Move on when you meet each stage’s "ready to move on" checkpoint.

faq.question: What does the roadmap cover?
faq.answer: Ten stages: Python and AI foundations (Stages 1–2), FDE SDLC documents and build (Stages 3–7), deploy and operations (Stages 8–9), and four e-commerce capstone projects (Stage 10). Stages 3–9 use one customer story—Ask IT—while tutored labs use a smaller Todo app so beginners can practice safely before working on Ask IT alone.

faq.question: Why Todo in labs and Ask IT in assignments?
faq.answer: Stages 1–2 are concept labs only (no customer storyline). From Stage 3 onward, tutored labs use the Todo app and assignments use the Ask IT retail scenario.

faq.question: What will I be able to do after?
faq.answer: Stand up tested APIs and RAG prototypes, run customer discovery, produce BRDs and architecture diagrams, develop and test solutions, deploy to Render or AWS, configure Langfuse observability, pass enterprise security reviews, and build multi-agent applications.

faq.question: How are the 48 hours split?
faq.answer: Section 1 is 16 hours (5h Python and FastAPI + 11h AI engineering). Section 2 is 16 hours covering Stages 3 through 9 across the full customer engagement lifecycle. Section 3 is 16 hours dedicated to four 4-hour hands-on capstone projects.

faq.question: What are the Capstone Projects in Section 3?
faq.answer: Four 4-hour projects: 1) E-commerce Full-Stack Application (React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL), 2) Single Agent & Multi-Agent (LangGraph orchestration & specialists), 3) Agentic RAG (FAISS retrieval & cited answers), and 4) Integrated Application (unified commerce platform combining multi-agent and RAG).

faq.question: Is progress saved? Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Progress is saved in your browser (localStorage). No login or backend is required for the FDE roadmap.

capstone.title: Section 3: Capstone Projects (16h)
capstone.intro: Four hands-on capstone projects (4 hours each): E-commerce Full-Stack Application, Single Agent + Multi-Agent Orchestration, Agentic RAG with FAISS, and one Integrated Application combining all three.
deliverables: Project 1: E-commerce Full-Stack Application (ReactJS frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, customer journey)
Project 2: E-commerce Single Agent + Multi-Agent (LangGraph orchestrator, Product Search Agent, Cart Agent, Order Agent)
Project 3: E-commerce Agentic RAG (Product document prep, embeddings, FAISS vector index, grounded cited answers)
Project 4: Integrated E-Commerce Application (Single app combining full-stack commerce, multi-agent store actions, and RAG product manual assistance)

strongWork.title: Full-stack commerce verified first
strongWork.body: Browse, cart, checkout, and order persistence in PostgreSQL are tested before AI layers are added.

strongWork.title: Clear agent responsibilities
strongWork.body: LangGraph orchestrator routes to specialist agents with scoped database tool permissions and clear boundaries.

strongWork.title: Grounded RAG retrieval
strongWork.body: FAISS retrieval over approved manuals provides citations and explicit "I don’t know" refusal behavior without cart mutations.

strongWork.title: Single unified interface
strongWork.body: One React client and FastAPI service cleanly separating store actions and product manual assistance modes.

stages.name: Software Engineering (Python)

Write Python that handles files, JSON, and API calls safely
Validate request and response data with Pydantic
Ship a minimal tested FastAPI service
stages.readyWhen: You can explain the course flow and stand up a tested FastAPI API with /health and one resource in a day.

stages.name: FDE SDLC: Business requirement

Conduct structured discovery with the IT sponsor
Produce a one-page business requirements document (BRD)

stages.name: FDE SDLC: UI/UX Solution
stages.cardBlurb: Read Ask IT UX rules; Todo lab for wireframes; Ask IT UI assignment.
stages.description: Learn Ask IT chat UX in readings. Todo lab: UI/UX brief. Assignment: Ask IT UI/UX on your own.

Document user flow for answer and no-answer paths
Produce wireframes aligned to the BRD

stages.description: Reference architecture, permissions, cost, and decisions.
outcomes: Document end-to-end architecture for Ask IT
Define role-based FAQ access on the server
Estimate monthly AI cost and record one architecture decision
stages.readyWhen: Diagram, FAQ tags, cost estimate, and ADR are documented and explainable.

stages.name: Development
stages.cardBlurb: Todo labs: build API and UI with tutor. Assignments: run Ask IT locally and test.
stages.description: Tutored Todo labs for FastAPI and React. Assignments: Ask IT startup, tests, and fix loops on your own.
outcomes: Build Todo API and UI in labs with your tutor
Complete Ask IT local run and test-plan assignments independently
Use prompt → checkpoint → fix prompts when builds fail
Document staff vs admin checks before pilot
stages.readyWhen: Todo labs pass checkpoints; Ask IT assignment shows local run and test notes; staff vs admin behavior documented.

practise.title: Fix a failed test and rerun

stages.name: MVP/POC: Local and Render validation
stages.cardBlurb: Todo Lab 6: local, Docker, Render POC (tutor). Ask IT assignment: pilot deploy and checklist (solo).

Run regression and three pilot sessions; triage top fixes

stages.name: Production deployment
stages.cardBlurb: Todo labs: production config and runbook drill. Ask IT assignment: pre-rollout checklist.
stages.description: Production on Render or AWS; secrets, runbook, and operations.

Author a one-page runbook for common failures
stages.readyWhen: Production URL is stable, secrets are in environment config, and a peer resolved a simulated outage using the runbook.

stages.name: Enterprise AI FDE
stages.cardBlurb: Todo labs: traces and handover template. Ask IT assignment: security pack and sponsor readout.
stages.description: Security, Langfuse observability, evals, and sponsor handover.

Configure Langfuse for traces and regression eval visibility
Deliver handover package and sponsor readout
stages.readyWhen: Security answers and Langfuse evidence exist; five-minute sponsor readout is rehearsed.

stages.name: Capstone Project
stages.cardBlurb: Four capstone projects: e-commerce full-stack, single agent and multi-agent, agentic RAG, and one integrated application.
stages.description: Four capstone projects: e-commerce full-stack, single agent and multi-agent, agentic RAG, and one integrated application.
outcomes: Demonstrate the ReactJS → FastAPI → PostgreSQL e-commerce flow.
Demonstrate a single-agent baseline and a LangGraph multi-agent assistant with specialist routing.
Demonstrate document ingestion, FAISS retrieval and grounded Agentic RAG answers.
Demonstrate one integrated e-commerce application with separate store-action and product-manual assistant modes.
stages.readyWhen: One integrated application demonstrates full-stack shopping, multi-agent store assistance and Agentic RAG in separate modes.
